channel.title: Divine Link Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for Divine Link

item.title: Version 1.5.1
item.description:
Smaller download, smarter recognition

  • Divine Link is now a small universal download. On Apple Silicon Macs, the enhanced on-device speech model downloads once on first launch (with a progress bar) and then works fully offline.
  • Intel Macs use the built-in speech recogniser automatically — no extra download.
  • Reliability improvements and safer fallback when the model is not yet installed.

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
Version 1.4.0

  • More reliable live transcription — no longer drops words after pauses
  • Now recognises references spoken in reverse: "John verse 16 chapter 5"
  • Stability improvements

item.title: Version 1.3.10
item.description:
Release 1.3.10

  • Stabilised Stripe webhook delivery and post-payment confirmation flow.
  • Updated payment link redirects and billing diagnostics.

item.title: Version 1.3.8
item.description:
Version 1.3.8 — External Audio Device Transcription Fix

Bug Fix

  • External devices now transcribe – USB interfaces, audio mixers, and virtual devices (BlackHole) now transcribe correctly. Previously only the built-in MacBook microphone produced transcription; all other sources were silent despite audio flowing. Root cause: the speech recognition restart timer was firing on a background thread RunLoop that was not spinning, so transcription permanently stalled after any device switch.

item.title: Version 1.3.7
item.description:
Version 1.3.7 — Audio Device Switch Fix

Bug Fixes

  • Audio device switching fixed – Switching the audio input device no longer freezes audio capture.
  • BlackHole wording clarified – Settings no longer says BlackHole is “required”.

item.title: Version 1.3.6
item.description:
Version 1.3.6 — Transcription Reliability Fix

Bug Fix

  • Transcription always starts – Fixed a silent failure where the audio meter was active but no transcription text appeared. On devices where the on-device speech model is unavailable (e.g. not downloaded for this language), the app now automatically falls back to server-based recognition.

item.title: Version 1.3.5
item.description:
Version 1.3.5 — Transcript & Compatibility Update

Live Transcript Improvements

  • Transcript now persists – Spoken sentences are no longer wiped when a new sentence begins. Each sentence is committed as a scrollable line, just like dictating to a document.
  • Native text selection – Words and phrases in the transcript can now be selected with click, double-click, or drag for review and correction.
  • Auto-scroll with user override – The transcript auto-scrolls to the latest line. Scrolling up pauses auto-scroll; it resumes automatically when you return to the bottom.

Audio Reliability

  • Silent transcription fixed – Disabled Voice Processing I/O which conflicted with Apple Speech, causing HALC overload and no text output despite the audio meter being active.
  • Swift concurrency fixes – Resolved Sendable closure warnings that could cause threading instability on some machines.

Session Transcript File

  • Structured format – Saved transcript files now include a service header (name, date, pastor, duration), a “Detected Scriptures” section with verse text and timestamps, and the full per-line transcript.

macOS Compatibility

  • macOS 14 & 15 support – App now runs on macOS Sonoma (14) and Sequoia (15) in addition to macOS Tahoe (16).

item.title: Version 1.3.4
item.description:
What's New in Version 1.3.4

In-App Updates Fixed

  • Sparkle sandbox fix - In-app updates now work correctly. The "error occurred while launching the installer" issue is resolved for sandboxed builds.
  • Installer XPC Service enabled and entitlements added so updates can install from within the app.

Includes all fixes from 1.3.3 (admin tab security, premium state enforcement, auth sync, cache hygiene).

item.title: Version 1.3.3
item.description:
What's New in Version 1.3.3

Security & State Fixes

  • Admin Tab Security - Admin tab now only visible when signed in AND user is an administrator. Completely hidden for unauthenticated users.
  • Premium State Enforcement - Premium features, settings, and UI elements are now strictly gated behind authentication. Cached subscription data from previous sessions can no longer leak through.
  • Reactive Auth Synchronisation - SubscriptionService and AdManager now reactively observe authentication state. When a session expires or user signs out, all premium/admin state resets instantly.
  • Cache Hygiene - Stale subscription data is now fully cleared from UserDefaults on sign-out or session expiry, preventing privileged state from persisting across launches.

Improvements

  • Airtight authentication guards across all premium-gated views and services
  • Improved settings window resize behaviour
  • Admin debug: simulate free mode for testing ads and tint as admin

item.title: Version 1.3.2
item.description:
What's New in Version 1.3.2

New Features

  • Contact Us Form - Paid customers can now reach support directly from the app
  • Subscription Grace Period - 14-day grace period with countdown banner if payment lapses
  • Subscription Warning Banner - Clear visual notification when subscription needs attention

Improvements

  • Premium Paywall UX with tier and billing period comparison
  • Pastor profile limits enforced per tier (Grace: 2, Love: 5)
  • Device limits now tier-aware (Mercy: 1, Grace: 2, Love: 5)
  • Detection Settings gated behind premium subscription
  • Monthly and yearly billing period selection

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed login verification code not accepting 6-digit OTP
  • Fixed Stripe webhook to correctly differentiate Grace and Love tiers
  • Fixed subscription status not recognising new tier statuses

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
What's New in Version 1.1.0

New Features

  • Video Ads - Ads now support YouTube videos (including Shorts) with auto-loop
  • GIF Ads - Animated GIF support with smooth looping
  • Direct Video Files - MP4 video file support for ads
  • Always-Visible Titles - Ad titles now displayed with transparent overlay

Improvements

  • Privacy-enhanced YouTube embedding (youtube-nocookie.com)
  • Minimised YouTube branding where possible
  • Improved admin dashboard with side-by-side form layout
  • Video preview in admin dashboard

Technical

  • Added VideoPlayerView, YouTubeWebView, GIFWebView components
  • Updated Supabase function to support video ads

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
What's New in Version 1.0.2

New Features

  • Ad-Supported Free Version - App now free with optional Premium subscription
  • Premium Subscription - Remove ads with monthly subscription
  • Auto-Updates - App now updates automatically via Sparkle

Improvements

  • Default font size changed to Medium for better readability
  • Improved scripture detection validation
  • Larger, cleaner ad layout

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed verse number validation (rejects invalid references)
  • Fixed verse range validation

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
Version 1.0.1

  • Added accessibility settings with font size scaling
  • Added ProPresenter Audience screen push
  • Improved window resizability
  • Fixed scripture detection issues
